information_scope: same fixed PT-Z-001; only public active actor schedules; no private opponent hand, deck order or future encounter reveal
ui_diff_scope: v0.11 to v0.12 UI sources; nine-source reproduction including existing relations.js; offline Lucide subset and catalogue inspection added
unverified: real browser right edge, centered layout, art visibility and translucent-window readability
physical gallery hover paths and held-card pointer contact
human effort, errors and event-feed readability

gesture_policy.motion_before_hold: horizontal browsing regardless of direction; locked until release
gesture_policy.whole_page_vertical_scroll: outside card surfaces; also on cards when drag disabled
gesture_policy.selection_after_hold: held card remains selected after release or cancellation; pre-hold browsing preserves previous selection

held_card.edges: clamp within frame while retaining pointer contact

presentation.action_anchor: one execution button directly below selected card, clamped inside hand viewport; placement label is 場に出す
presentation.outside_window: pinned menu windows dismiss without background action; direct withdrawal remains actionable; object windows allow direct switching and card inspector allows execution; catalogue has its own outside/Escape dismissal

live_history.location: transient pointer-transparent overlay at field lower right; no reserved layout height

presentation.artwork: existing Lucide 1.8.0 icons bundled offline, license retained in icons.js; same kind artwork across hand/field/deck; actor art minimum 42px separate from caption; terrain base/environment layering retained
presentation.hand_background: continuous terrain across entire game screen
presentation.menu_location: slim single-row bottom strip with horizontally scrollable status and menus when needed
presentation.player_status_location: single bottom row, HP first, hand count included
presentation.prediction: faint connectors between actual hand, field and target objects below windows; public numeric prediction/formulas retained in card details
presentation.card_window_height_px: space from 16px below root top to 8px before hand; at least 160px
presentation.adoption: v0.12: bounded centered frame, visible provisional art, hover hold-state preview, pictorial deck gallery, pin glyphs, short titles, withdrawal/re-entry and separate breakthrough outcomes; rendering not verified
presentation.persistent_text: actor/card actionable state and current next-turn icons; no region headings or idle gesture instructions
presentation.help: on-demand operation/settings window; formal tutorial not implemented
presentation.breakthrough: current objectives listed separately: O grants unprotected R; V0 grants T0 and protects acquired items; fixed replace_environment transitions; no future actors shown

action_order.participants: all active actors that act, including player; next action once per actor
action_order.sort: next_at ascending; ties V, P, E, then actor ID
action_order.display: small horizontal artwork/fallback icons plus delay; full names and absolute times on demand
action_order.overflow: horizontal scrolling and conditional previous/next controls
action_order.update: after game state changes; selection does not assume future actions

presentation.card_window_targets: legal active targets selectable within the large inspector
presentation.selection: closing window retains selected card; no explicit deselect button; initial and post-action card selection remains empty
presentation.target: restored fixed PT-Z-001 initial V0, retained while active, otherwise first active displayed participant
presentation.deadline_copy: provisional あとN行動 / 今回まで; own-action decrement explained in details

hover.dismiss: leave trigger and window when peeking; same opener/outside/Esc when pinned
hover.switch: click different opener; hover does not replace pinned content

object_details.field: full public card effects/costs/expiry definition/loss conditions; preserves selected hand
object_details.actor: current public stats, next action, existing behavior and observed card types; click also selects target
object_details.toggle: same object closes, different visible object switches
object_details.internal_target: changes target while retaining card detail

board_connections.layer: above objects, below lightly translucent windows and drag ghost; pointer-transparent

paths.place: hand to empty same-attribute field; no target leg
paths.attack: hand to matching field card to current target
paths.guard_heal_none: hand to matching field card to player status

board_connections.source: actual DOM rectangles clipped to their scrolling viewport
board_connections.update: selection, target, game state, all endpoint scrolling, container resize
board_connections.offscreen: omit segment with fully offscreen endpoint; existing scrolling hints remain
board_connections.window_occlusion: window tint and blur obscure overlapping segments; closing window retains full route

screen.fallback: below readable minimum height, keep height and scroll page/regions; do not force all sizes to 16:9
screen.adoption: provisional product-oriented baseline; final supported resolutions not adopted
screen.width: border-box width/max-width 100%, min-width 0, margin-inline auto; independent of aspect-ratio intrinsic width
screen.standalone_width: border-box body, width 100%, max 1440px, symmetric 16px padding

window_layout.hand: wide area above hand, up to 840px
window_layout.field: natural height, up to 420px; above entire field row if fitting, else below; cap in larger free region if neither fits
window_layout.actor: natural height, up to 420px; below entire actor row preferred
window_layout.objective_order: natural height up to 420px width; above bottom strip / below order strip
window_layout.reference_history_settings: natural height up to 560px width, capped above bottom strip

presentation.action_hover: mouse hover on current execution button reuses held ghost, field highlight and hand fade; no action/selection/state mutation; leave/click/change/blur clears
presentation.window_state: Pin / PinOff icon, accessible role and label, no visible pinned/temporary prose

deck_gallery.title: 山札一覧
deck_gallery.tiles: same public catalogue, art + name + attribute + undrawn count; zero count dimmed
deck_gallery.details: hover 180ms; leave grace 160ms; click to pin/toggle; keyboard/touch buttons; full effects and hand count
deck_gallery.window: up to 320px; beside source, otherwise above/below; clipped to available height with content scroll
deck_gallery.knowledge: known types are observations, not current opponent composition; scope annotation retained only in docs

presentation.exit_flow: direct cautionary 撤退 in footer → exact fixed settlement → 帰還 with kept/lost items → 再突入 of same build/seed; no persistent growth added
presentation.in_play_resources: removed separate bring/supply/reward section; bring/supply in history, kept/lost items after settlement
